description: Source code for a Microsoft PowerPoint document loader class implementing INode interface, handling file input, processing, and output of documents and text.

classes.name: MicrosoftPowerpoint_DocumentLoaders

methods.description: Main method to initialize document loading, process files, and produce document and text outputs.
